title: SenderOutput::Retransmit.position field is always 0 and unused
description:
In ack_on_error.rs, `SenderOutput::Retransmit` includes a `position: u8` field (line 85):

```rust
Retransmit {
    window: u8,
    missing_bitmap: u64,
    position: u8,  // Always 0
}
```

Every construction site sets position to 0 (line 404):
```rust
SenderOutput::Retransmit {
    window: ack.window,
    missing_bitmap: missing,
    position: 0,  // <-- always literal 0
}
```

Callers use `retransmit_iter(window, missing_bitmap)` instead, which tracks position internally.

What goes wrong: Dead field adds cognitive load - readers wonder what it's for. Struct is larger than needed.

Rewrite: Remove the position field entirely:
```rust
Retransmit { window: u8, missing_bitmap: u64 }
```

Files: /Volumes/Attic/Desktop/Projects/crates/schc/src/fragment/ack_on_error.rs
close_reason: Removed unused SenderOutput::Retransmit.position field. The field was always initialized to 0 and never read - actual retransmission iteration uses RetransmitIter with its own internal position tracking.
